# Pipeline Diagrams

> Whiteboard-proof diagrams for data pipelines. A handful of shapes (processors, data stores, triggers, flows) to design, describe and explain how data moves between systems. Diagrams as code: write a few lines of text in a ```pipeline code block, and the npm package `pipeline-diagrams` checks it, lays it out and draws it as SVG or Mermaid. No dependencies; it runs in a browser, on the command line, in Markdown and in AI agents.

To draw a diagram, read the agent guide first: it has the whole language on one page. Write the diagram in a ```pipeline code block. Where `pipeline` blocks aren't rendered (GitHub, most chats), add a Mermaid version as well.

Check and render a diagram from the command line, without installing anything first:

```sh
npx -y pipeline-diagrams diagram.pipeline --check   # errors and warnings, with line numbers and fixes
npx -y pipeline-diagrams diagram.pipeline out/      # out/diagram.svg and out/diagram-dark.svg
```

## For agents

- [Agent guide]({{ site.url }}/downloads/pipeline-diagrams-agent-guide.md): the language on one page, with the shapes, the flows, an example and the rules
- [Skill]({{ site.url }}/SKILL.md): the agent guide as an Agent Skill (SKILL.md), for Claude Code and other agents that load skills
- [For AI agents]({{ site.url }}/agents.html): the Claude Code plugin, the MCP server, and setup for other agents
- [Useful prompts]({{ site.url }}/prompts.html): prompts that get a map of every data flow in a repository

## Docs

- [Language reference]({{ site.url }}/text-format.html): every statement, the grammar, and every error and warning
- [The notation]({{ site.url }}/notation.html): the shapes and what they mean
- [Install & tools]({{ site.url }}/install.html): the npm package, command line tools, Markdown plugins and the GitHub renderer
- [In your browser]({{ site.url }}/browser.html): the `<pipeline-diagram>` element and the offline viewer

## Install for Claude Code

The plugin has the skill and the MCP server:

```text
/plugin install pipeline-diagrams --marketplace Sparkboxx/pipeline-modelling
```

## MCP server

```sh
npx -y -p pipeline-diagrams pipeline-diagrams-mcp
```

Tools: `pipeline_guide`, `check_pipeline`, `render_pipeline`, `pipeline_to_mermaid`.
